dialogues.text: 『哪吒你也太大膽了，看我怎麼收拾你。』
『大爺，小龍有眼不識泰山，你大人不計小人過吧。』
『好小子，竟敢偷本龍王的寶貝，今兒個非殺了你，丟出去餵魚。』
『老夫今兒個不殺你了，滾吧！』
『喂！你就是鬧海的哪吒吧！小小年紀不學好，我替父親修理你。』
『哼！只會欺負小女生，討厭！』
哪吒！我三個弟弟已派人向我報告你的惡行，今兒個你又闖入本宮，看來老夫得親自出手教訓你。

source.transcriptionLimit: Normal screenshot transcription; exact punctuation/font equivalence not claimed.

dialogues.text: 東海龍王：可惡！小龍女你出來。

source.transcriptionLimit: Normal screenshot transcription; exact punctuation/font equivalence not claimed.

source.transcriptionLimit: Normal screenshot transcription; exact punctuation/font equivalence not claimed.

source.transcriptionLimit: Normal screenshot transcription; exact punctuation/font equivalence not claimed.

dialogues.text: 哪吒：小龍女？原來是你從旁相助。

source.transcriptionLimit: Normal screenshot transcription; exact punctuation/font equivalence not claimed.

dialogues.text: 東海龍王：哪吒！你父母生下你這惡子，大鬧我四海龍宮，我要向玉帝奏告，由他來處罰你們全家，哼！你真是李家滅門絕戶的禍胎。

source.transcriptionLimit: Normal screenshot transcription; exact punctuation/font equivalence not claimed.

dialogues.text: 哪吒：不！我一人做事一人當，請不要連累我爹娘，現在我把肉身還給爹娘，你不要連累他們好不好！

source.transcriptionLimit: Normal screenshot transcription; exact punctuation/font equivalence not claimed.

dialogues.text: 東海龍王：你是說真的？

source.transcriptionLimit: Normal screenshot transcription; exact punctuation/font equivalence not claimed.

dialogues.text: 哪吒拿起劍刺向自己，身子倒在地上，死了．哪吒身體雖死，但靈魂仍存在．

source.transcriptionLimit: Normal screenshot transcription; exact punctuation/font equivalence not claimed.

dialogues.text: 乾元山太乙真人到．

source.transcriptionLimit: Normal screenshot transcription; exact punctuation/font equivalence not claimed.

dialogues.text: 太乙真人：龍王兄，哪吒鬧海是天數，不該麻煩玉帝的．

source.transcriptionLimit: Normal screenshot transcription; exact punctuation/font equivalence not claimed.

dialogues.text: 太乙真人：哪吒，你本來是我弟子靈珠子，你本性中火氣太暴，要修成正果必須多努力．事情還沒有結束，現在你要進入地獄，修練心性，希望你能通過考驗。

source.transcriptionLimit: Normal screenshot transcription; exact punctuation/font equivalence not claimed.

dialogues.text: 小龍女堅決與哪吒同行一起進入地獄．

reference.validation: Bound message IDs/records; full text remains PROVISIONAL_REFERENCE unless a specific original screen is reviewed.

dialogues.text: 这些人在世制造伪药，害人不浅，所以用药水灌服，此药极苦，一入口便肚痛又想呕吐，这是报应。

reference.validation: Bound message IDs/records; full text remains PROVISIONAL_REFERENCE unless a specific original screen is reviewed.

dialogues.text: 我是五官王，对于为恶者，死后要接受一连串的折磨，善有善报恶有恶报，切记！

reference.validation: Bound message IDs/records; full text remains PROVISIONAL_REFERENCE unless a specific original screen is reviewed.

reference.validation: Bound message IDs/records; full text remains PROVISIONAL_REFERENCE unless a specific original screen is reviewed.

dialogues.text: 请不要打扰我的工作。

reference.validation: Bound message IDs/records; full text remains PROVISIONAL_REFERENCE unless a specific original screen is reviewed.

dialogues.text: 所谓诛心，是诛其贪淫心，毁谤心，污昧心。
